title.narrative: West Africa Food System Resilience Program (FSRP) Phase 2 - Ghana Tomato Value Chain

description.narrative: The overall objective of FSRP is to increase preparedness against food insecurity and improve the resilience of food systems in West Africa, including Ghana. Phase 2 will overall benefit 300,000 farming families in Ghana. The Norwegian bilateral contribution will strengthen the tomato value chain in Ghana and increase production to meet the supply gap. The Norwegian support will benefit approximately 1,500 tomato producers directly. They will benefit in terms of productivity gains, income increase, and enhanced climate resilience. The project will actively encourage participation of women and promote gender-sensitive technologies. Beneficiaries would include at least 40% women.
